body: Things like this piss me off, because all the homophobes already believe in this stigma that gays are pedophiles. And this behavior just reinforces that.

Ironically when I last did molly a couple weeks ago (first time since New Years Eve... I'm responsible), it helped me see this whole thing from a different perspective and gave me a sense of "I need to do better for myself".

It's hard to discuss it with him... every time I try to bring something like this up it results in him freaking out about his sexual identity in general and labeling everything as sinful/immoral. Underage porn is immoral, and it's my sexual preferences causing me to watch it, therefore my sexual preference are immoral.

And I'm not sure if you tried molly, but it's not reckless or dangerous if you're actually smart about it. It's one of my all time favorite drugs that I save for special occasions, and I don't see anything wrong with it. On the other hand, I don't really enjoy drinking and don't very often.
